title: views.open fails with expired_trigger_id when the modal opens after a database call
symptoms: Modal opens in local testing but not in production
Failure only when the handler awaits another API or a cold start first
cause: A trigger_id expires three seconds after Slack sends it. Any lookup, cold start or queue hop before views.open can push past that window.
fix: Call views.open first with a loading view, then fill it in with views.update once the slow data arrives.
affected: Slack modals opened from shortcuts, slash commands and block actions, as of 2026-10
